Players Committee card image of [[Visage Of The Emperor (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Lose 2 Force to ▼ on Vader's Castle. Your Force generation here may not be limited. Each player loses 1 Force at the end of their own turn. Once per game, may take a lightsaber into hand. [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.
